Subject: FINAL NOTICE - INV-2027-303 / INV-2027-304 (outstanding) + WHT clarification

Hi James / Pivotal accounts team,

I’m following up on two overdue invoices for Pivotal Health (INV-2027-303, INV-2027-304) that remain unpaid beyond our standard terms. Total outstanding: EUR 78,640.

We understand there may be withholding tax (WHT) applied on your side. To close this out quickly we need either:

- proof of payment for the gross amount (so that Redwood receives the full invoice amount), or
- the local WHT certificate showing the tax withheld (so we can apply the credit), or
- confirmation you will remit the withheld portion to Redwood’s EU entity and provide remittance evidence.

Attachments: INV-2027-303.pdf, INV-2027-304.pdf (copies attached for your reference).

Given the size and the age of these items, I need a concrete payment path by end of week (Fri 30 Jul) or I’ll escalate to our finance leadership and consider placing services on hold for the Pivotal account.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: FINAL NOTICE - INV-2027-303 / INV-2027-304 (outstanding) + WHT clarification

Hi Markus —

Apologies for the delay and thanks for the heads-up. We buy Redwood via our corporate procurement team and payments for marketplace and platform subscriptions are routed through our AP team. For the two invoices above: we have initiated payment but have withheld 15% WHT against the vendor amount due to local tax guidance. We can either:

1) Pay the net amount we have already approved to our bank (expected value date 31 Jul) and then provide a WHT withholding certificate once the local tax authority issues it (usually within 5 business days), or
2) Gross-up the payment so Redwood receives the full invoice amount (we need confirmation of applicable tax treatment and beneficiary account details to process gross-up), or
3) Route the payment to your UK entity instead of your continental EU entity (requires updated remittance instructions).

Which option would you prefer? I can chase the AP team to change the routing if needed but need clear instructions from Redwood today to avoid payment reversal. I’ll attach the AP remittance stub once the payment is sent.

Best,
James
Finance Manager
Pivotal Health

Markus / Laura —

Forwarding James’ response. Quick thoughts:

- If they pay net and provide a WHT certificate within 5–7 business days we can post the credit. Finance needs the tax certificate to claim the credit; if they don’t provide it then we’ll need to either refund the WHT (gross-up) or escalate.
- Gross-up requests for EU accounts are operationally painful and require updated banking details + tax advice. Avoid if possible.
- Routing to the UK entity could be a pragmatic short-term fix if their AP can change the remit quickly. We should confirm which Redwood legal entity they were invoiced to (invoice header shows Redwood EU Services Ltd.).

Action items:
1) Markus — can you confirm the beneficiary entity on the two invoices?
2) Laura — if we accept WHT certificate, can finance standby to validate when James sends it?
3) If no response from Pivotal by EOD Fri 30 Jul, we should escalate to commercial leadership for approval to suspend non-critical services.

Kimberly
Director, Credit & Collections
Redwood Inference

Hi James —

Thanks for the quick reply. The invoices were raised to Redwood EU Services Ltd (our Irish entity). Given that, our preference is:

1) If your AP can provide an official WHT withholding certificate to Redwood EU Services Ltd, we will accept the net payment and apply the WHT credit upon validation. Please send the certificate to finance@redwoodinference.com and cc me.

2) If providing a certificate will take longer than 7 business days from payment date, please instead remit the full gross amount to the bank details shown on the invoice and then request local reimbursement from your tax authority. If you choose gross-up, confirm immediately so we can give AP the correct remit instructions.

To avoid service disruption, we’ll hold off on any suspension until EOD Mon 2 Aug provided we have payment confirmation (payment value date or remittance advice) by close of business on Fri 30 Jul. If we don’t see payment confirmation by then, we will escalate.

Regards,
